methods.label: Classify and count
methods.explanation: \(\sqrt{5}\), \(-\pi\), and \(0.1010010001\ldots\) (nonterminating and nonrepeating) are irrational. \(3.14\), \(\sqrt{16}=4\), \(22/7\), and \(\sqrt[3]{8}=2\) are all rational. There are \(3\) irrational numbers in total.
methods.levelReason: Uses Grade 7 irrational-number recognition, the supplied decimal pattern, and familiar square and cube roots.
